findings.evidence: We may use this enhanced personally identifiable information to notify you of special offers, updated information and new products and services from The Hill. Such collection, correlation, use and messages are beyond our control.

raw.denial_quote: We also require that these contractors (i) protect the privacy of your personally identifiable information consistent with this Privacy Policy, and (ii) not use or disclose your personally identifiable information for any purpose other than providing us with products or services for which we contracted.
raw.generic_quote: We may use this enhanced personally identifiable information to notify you of special offers, updated information and new products and services from The Hill. Such collection, correlation, use and messages are beyond our control.
raw.unspecified_purpose_quote: We collect personally identifiable information about you when you specifically and knowingly provide such information voluntarily on the Site, including, but not limited to, during the following interactions: (1) when you register on the Site and when you later log-on with your user name and password; (2) when you sign-up to subscribe to a service, a newsletter, or ask to be added to our mailing lists for other products or services; (3) when you place an order for products or services; (4) when you participate in a promotional offer; (5) when you provide feedback in an online survey; (6) when you submit other content and suggestions.
raw.rationale: The policy does not specify any particular purpose for the use of personally identifiable information, and explicitly states that personally identifiable information should not be disclosed to third parties for any purpose other than providing services.
